name: DATABRICKS_DSN
description: ODBC DSN

name: DATABRICKS_CATALOG
description: Catalog for all reads and writes

name: MDV_SCHEMA
description: MDV schema (the one the OC business rules read)

name: USE_QUARTERLY_TABLES
description: Read each MDV table as t_<name>_<vintage>

name: MDV_VINTAGE
description: The MDV extract's quarterly suffix; always named - a blank takes this default and is never derived from STUDY_END

name: STUDY_START
description: Study period start. Part of CONTRACT, so changing it needs NDMM_CONTRACT_OVERRIDE=TRUE

name: STUDY_END
description: Study period end. The same window as the Optum cohort; the MDV extract (2026q2) reaches past it

name: LOT1_FROM
description: 1L eligible-treatment period opens here. Part of CONTRACT, so changing it needs NDMM_CONTRACT_OVERRIDE=TRUE

name: PRE_LOT1_DAYS
description: Lookback and baseline window before the 1L index date

name: FU_CE_DAYS
description: Days after index the patient must still be observed at the hospital; 0 is the index date itself

name: OUTPATIENT_WINDOW_MONTHS
description: Two outpatient MM diagnosis months at most this many months apart confirm a diagnosis (the Optum rule's 90 days)

name: OTHER_MALIG_WINDOW_MONTHS
description: Two outpatient months for one cancer at most this many months apart confirm it (the Optum rule's 30 days)

name: MIN_AGE
description: Minimum age in the MM-diagnosis year

name: NDMM_INDEX_EXCLUDED_ABBRS
description: Agents barred from setting the 1L index beyond belantamab (protocol I3: panobinostat and elotuzumab). Pinned in the contract; separate with |

name: CODELIST_DIR
description: Where the MDV code lists live (MDV vocabulary; not the Optum lists)

name: MDV_TBL_DISEASE
description: MDV diagnosis table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_PATIENT
description: MDV patient table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_FF1
description: MDV DPC Form 1 episode table (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_DRUG
description: MDV drug master (base name)

name: MDV_TBL_ACT
description: MDV act table (base name)

name: MDV_COL_PATIENTID
description: Patient key in every table

name: MDV_COL_DATAMONTH
description: Claim month on the diagnosis table

name: MDV_COL_NYUGAIKBN
description: Care setting on the diagnosis table

name: MDV_COL_DISEASECODE
description: MDV disease code

name: MDV_COL_ICD10
description: ICD-10 code on the diagnosis table (NONE = the delivery has none; code lists must then use DISEASECODE)

name: MDV_COL_UTAGAIFLG
description: Suspected-diagnosis flag

name: MDV_COL_CANCERFLG
description: Cancer-diagnosis flag

name: MDV_COL_FROMDATE
description: Day-level diagnosis date compared with the FF1 episode

name: MDV_COL_SEX
description: Sex on the patient table

name: MDV_COL_BIRTH
description: Birth year / year-month / date on the patient table (CONFIRM the name)

name: MDV_COL_FF1STARTDATE
description: FF1 admission date

name: MDV_COL_FF1ENDDATE
description: FF1 discharge date

name: MDV_COL_CANCERFIRSTFLG
description: FF1 first-occurrence cancer flag

name: MDV_COL_CHEMOTHERAPYFLG
description: FF1 chemotherapy flag

name: MDV_COL_FF1_OUTCOME
description: FF1 discharge outcome (NONE = death is not observed; CONFIRM the name)

name: MDV_COL_RECEIPTCODE
description: Receipt code on the drug master and the act table

name: MDV_COL_RECEIPTNAME_ENG
description: English drug name on the drug master

name: MDV_COL_ACTDATE
description: Date of an act

name: MDV_COL_ACT_NYUGAIKBN
description: Care setting on the act table (NONE = not carried)

name: MDV_COL_ACT_DAYS
description: Days supplied on the act table (NONE = not carried; LOT imputes)

name: MDV_INPATIENT
description: nyugaikbn value for inpatient

name: MDV_OUTPATIENT
description: nyugaikbn value for outpatient

name: MDV_CONFIRMED
description: utagaiflg value for a confirmed diagnosis

name: MDV_CANCER
description: cancerflg value for a cancer diagnosis

name: MDV_FIRSTCANCER
description: cancerfirstflg value for a first occurrence

name: MDV_NO_CHEMO
description: chemotherapyflg value for no chemotherapy

name: MDV_SEX_MALE
description: sex value for male

name: MDV_SEX_FEMALE
description: sex value for female

name: MDV_DEATH_OUTCOMES
description: Discharge outcome values that are a death

name: NDMM_MDV_IP_RULE
description: What makes an inpatient MM diagnosis: none (nyugaikbn alone - the Optum rule), ff1 (and inside an FF1 episode), ff1_chemo (and that episode is a first cancer with chemotherapy - the OC rule)

name: NDMM_MDV_REQUIRE_CANCERFLG
description: The MM and other-cancer diagnoses must carry cancerflg (the OC base-population rule)
